# deed_entity (Data Source)

Reads the **effective view** of an entity: every source's facets merged (declarations, imports, runtime observations, annotations), including the computed status (health, freshness, validity). Look it up by `id`, or by `project`, `kind` and `name` (aliases of renamed entities included). Unlike the `deed_entity` resource, which holds only the provider's declaration, these values change as other sources report.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The effective view: every source merged, including observed status.
data "deed_entity" "nas" {
  project = "homelab"
  kind    = "server"
  name    = "nas-01"
}

output "nas_health" {
  value = data.deed_entity.nas.health
}

output "nas_observed" {
  value = jsondecode(data.deed_entity.nas.status).observed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Entity ID (`ent_…`).
- `kind` (String) Kind (with `project` and `name`).
- `name` (String) Entity name (with `project` and `kind`).
- `project` (String) Project name or ID (with `kind` and `name`).

### Read-Only

- `aliases` (List of String) Former names (after renames).
- `annotations` (Map of String) Effective annotations.
- `declared` (Boolean) Whether any declaring source (API, Terraform, …) declares the entity.
- `description` (String) Effective description.
- `display_name` (String) Effective display name.
- `environment` (String) Effective environment.
- `facets` (Number) Number of live facets (contributing sources).
- `freshness` (String) Freshness state: `fresh`, `aging`, `stale` or `unknown`.
- `health` (String) Health state: `ok`, `warning`, `failed` or `unknown`.
- `icon` (String) Effective icon.
- `labels` (Map of String) Effective labels.
- `lifecycle_stage` (String) Effective lifecycle stage.
- `links` (Attributes List) Effective links. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
- `owner` (String) Effective owner.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.
- `spec` (String) Effective spec as JSON.
- `status` (String) Computed status as JSON: health, freshness, observed values, validation, facet and conflict counts, findings.
- `tags` (List of String) Effective tags.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether the spec validates against the kind's storage schema.
- `version` (Map of String) Version information (`declared`, `observed`, `available`, `policy`, `channel`, `product`).

<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Read-Only:

- `title` (String) Title.
- `type` (String) Link type.
- `url` (String) URL.
